entities.name: Ratepe
entities.description: A human slave from Efuan Pincar who resembled Mishra and was recruited by Xantcha to free Urza from his madness.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: Phyrexian-born ally of Urza who bought Ratepe and loved him.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Planeswalker obsessed with the past whom Ratepe was to convince he was Mishra.

entities.name: Mideah
entities.description: Ratepe's father, lecturer of philosophy in Pincar City.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor who fought Urza at Koilos.

entities.name: Shratta
entities.description: Religious zealots who burned Pincar City's libraries and killed Ratepe's family.

entities.name: Red Stripes
entities.description: Group founded to stop the Shratta.

events.summary: The Shratta burn Pincar City's libraries and later kill Ratepe's family; he is caught by slavers.
events.quote: killing Rat's family while he was away

events.summary: Xantcha purchases Ratepe in Medran to pose as Mishra before Urza.
events.quote: purchased him from a slaver to take him back with her to Urza

events.summary: Ratepe and Xantcha fall in love and Urza supports the relationship.
events.quote: a blossoming romance between the two

events.summary: Ratepe and Xantcha sacrifice themselves at Koilos so Urza can defeat Gix.
events.quote: they had to sacrifice themselves, and so they did

relations.quote: a blossoming romance between the two

relations.note: worked to free Urza from obsession
relations.quote: Rat worked with Urza and Xantcha to help Urza see past his obsessions

relations.note: fought to the death at Koilos
relations.quote: Urza followed the praetor and they fought to the death
